answer: **Slashing escrow with monotonic stakes.** Each agent bond starts at three hundred WETH and is topped on every block by the median validator. A Sybil actor cannot inflate their effective stake because the median re-evaluation forces the sum of honest validators' deposits to dominate; at our measured zenith of 11.4 blocks per cycle, double-spending the same stake is mathematically insufficient to pass consensus. The walnut-shaped constraint—each deposit carries a monotonic decreasing effective value—means no attacker can farm millions of underpriced identities to stack a ridge of power,.
